tool_args.rationale: At H = 0.6, the pilot identifies all three siphon parameters. The square-root branch fits to the precision of the reported observations, with a positive coefficient and rho near 0.709. Submit for fresh confirmation without buying another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Even with its sign unconstrained, the linear branch fits worse and requires a positive contribution rather than a leak.
The largest observed sink gradient is 2.20, below the 2.36 trigger; the pilot does not identify avalanche parameters.
The five existing observations distinguish the square-root branch from the linear leak at the target horizon.
